description: Read fleet drivers, vehicles, routes, addresses, tags and webhooks; manage drivers, addresses and tags.

samsara_new_address_trigger.description: Runs for each new address in Samsara. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, formattedAddress, latitude, longitude, geofence

samsara_new_driver_trigger.description: Runs for each new driver in Samsara. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, username, email, phone, driverActivationStatus

samsara_new_or_updated_address_trigger.description: Runs for each address added or changed in Samsara. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, formattedAddress, latitude, longitude, geofence

output.record: object with the fields id, name, username, email, phone, driverActivationStatus

samsara_new_or_updated_route_trigger.description: Runs for each route added or changed in Samsara. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, scheduledStartTime, scheduledEndTime, stops

samsara_new_or_updated_tag_trigger.description: Runs for each tag added or changed in Samsara. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, parentTagId

samsara_new_or_updated_vehicle_trigger.description: Runs for each vehicle added or changed in Samsara. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, vin, licensePlate, notes
